findings.finding_id: plugin/skills/faff/bin/lib/budget.js::in-flight runs whose until has already passed now stop at the first check
findings.title: in-flight runs whose until has already passed now stop at the first check
findings.action: No change: intended behaviour, pinned by the resume and missing-anchor tests.
findings.disposition_rationale: This is the intended behaviour change (spec §4.2 and the methodology critique's risk profile): a run minted before this fix with a passed until, or resumed after its deadline, breaches at its next check. Pinned by the resume and missing-anchor tests.

findings.finding_id: test/budget.test.mjs::holdout-shaped resume fixture omits utc_offset_min on the current owner, so its until_at depends on the box timezone
findings.title: holdout-shaped resume fixture omits utc_offset_min on the current owner, so its until_at depends on the box timezone
findings.action: Add utc_offset_min to the resumed owner or assert the no-offset warning.
findings.refutation: runOrigin takes the offset from the origin entry, owner_history[0], which carries utc_offset_min: 0; the current owner's missing offset is never read. The same fixture run under TZ=UTC, TZ=Asia/Kolkata and TZ=America/Los_Angeles reports breached [until], until_at 2026-10-30T07:30:00.000Z and no warnings in all three. The fixture mirrors the spec's holdout scenario, where only owner_history[0] states an offset.
findings.disposition_rationale: Refuted against the code and a three-timezone run of the fixture.

occurrences.title: holdout-shaped resume fixture omits utc_offset_min on the current owner, so its until_at depends on the box timezone

findings.finding_id: test/budget.test.mjs::the no-run test writes .faffrc.yaml inline instead of through fixture()
findings.title: the no-run test writes .faffrc.yaml inline instead of through fixture()
findings.action: No change: the no-run case cannot use fixture(), which always creates a run dir.
findings.disposition_rationale: fixture() always creates a run dir, which the no-run case must not have; the inline write mirrors fixture()'s own write and the finally block cleans up. No behaviour defect.
